shared_elements: relief carving on a flat stone slab
registers or vertical stacking of motifs
repeated linear incised patterning (rows of parallel lines/hatching)
justification: Both are low-relief carved slabs showing profile creatures and repeated incised linear patterning, and both include a plant-like element, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a stacked sequence of schematic animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like form) with no human presence and highly abstracted outline-plus-flat-relief bodies, while B is dominated by a single large naturalistically modelled anthropomorphic winged figure with detailed beard, garment and feathered wings holding an object beside a stylized tree, an iconographic scheme absent from A.
